steps.domain_action: Initialize with 320-digit analytic fiducial coordinates.
Assign identity to candidate coordinate z_k.
Compute lindep fit for z_k up to degree 288.
Branch lindep result into degree-check and height-stability check.
Check if candidate degree d_k divides 288.
Degree-check passes (e.g., d_k = 8, 16, or 32).
Increase precision to 1500 digits and re-run lindep.
Monitor denominator bit-length for growth vs. stability.
Denominator height stays constant (genuine signature).
Recombine successful degree and stability checks.
Flag z_k as 'GENUINE' and bank in small_minpolys.txt.
Move to next candidate coordinate z_{k+1}.
Compute lindep fit for z_{k+1}.
Branch lindep result into degree-check and height-stability check.
Evaluate degree d_{k+1} against field conductor.
Degree fails (e.g., d_k = 139 which does not divide 288).
Observe height doubling when precision is increased.
Height-stability check fails (artifact signature).
Recombine failed indicators.
Hold in temporary batch to check for shared-field Galois conjugates.
Permanently tag z_{k+1} as 'ARTIFACT' and abandon fit.
Close the registry for the dimension d=12 fiducial set.
